a: To wander with no set path
A careful look back at finished work, to see if it holds up
The last part of a story
d: Written in a secret way, or written as software
Eager, like a reader who never puts the book down
n: An audit is a look back at finished work to see if it holds up. You can run a small one on anything an AI tool gives you. Pick three facts from the answer: a number, a date and a claim about what a document says. Check each one yourself against the source. If all three hold, you have a reason to lean on the rest. If one fails, you know to check everything. Three checks take two minutes, and they tell you how much to trust the page in front of you.
